Switch to the other account in Clash, then export and sync it as usual (Settings > More Settings > Data Export > Copy, then Sync). It\'s added by itself, with its own timers and notifications.\n\nTo see it on your home screen, add another Clash Timers widget and pick the account. On some phones you can also long-press a widget and tap Settings to switch it.
Its timers and notifications stop, and widgets showing it switch to another account. Sync its export again to bring it back.

SET UP (ONCE)
1. Add the widget: long-press the home screen, tap Widgets and drag Clash Timers on. Make it tall. If it doesn't all fit, tap a section title on the widget to fold it. There's also a small Next to finish widget showing only the next upgrade.
2. Add the sync tile: pull the notification shade all the way down, tap edit (pencil, or ⋮ then Edit) and drag Clash Sync into your tiles.
3. Settings > Apps > Clash Timers > Battery > Unrestricted, so the widget keeps updating.

SYNC YOUR VILLAGE
1. In Clash: Settings > More Settings > Data Export > Copy.
2. Pull down and tap Clash Sync. You stay in the game. (Or tap Sync on the widget, or the button below.)

Sync again whenever you start an upgrade, finish one early or use a potion. The widget only knows what was true at your last export.

MORE THAN ONE ACCOUNT
Export and sync each account the same way. Each one is added by itself. When you add a widget, you pick which account it shows.

Turn on while Hammer Jam (or another event that halves upgrade times) is running, and off when it ends. Upgrades you start while it\'s on then get the right progress bar. Timers and notifications are right either way.

Help us fix bugs and keep up with game updates. Tap below and your email app opens with everything filled in, so you just press send. Your player tag is taken out first. Your app version, phone and boost and Hammer Jam settings are included. It\'s kept private and only used for testing.

• A Builder Bite running with a Builder Potion now counts: builders run at 11x, and the widget shows a chip for each. • Fixed: Time to max counted supercharges on plain Wizard Towers, which the game no longer has.

• Share your export: help fix bugs and keep up with game updates by emailing your village export to the developer. Your email app opens with everything filled in, so you just press send. Your player tag is taken out first.
• Next to finish: a small one-line widget with just the next upgrade to finish and its countdown, plus anything idle. Add it from your home screen\'s widget list.

• Fixed: the widget could keep showing the helpers line or the Home, Builder Base and All buttons from another account or an earlier sync.\n• Fixed: the \"Helpers ready in\" countdown didn\'t come back once the helpers had been ready.

• Running supercharges show the stage being worked on, with a progress bar, instead of a level that doesn\'t exist.\n• The widget\'s Home, Builder Base and All buttons now show whenever you have a Builder Base, even with nothing upgrading there.
• Potions: see whether now is a good time for a Builder, Research or Pet potion, and how much time it would save.\n• Fixed: during a Study Soup, pet upgrades could count down far too fast.

• Bedtime planner: see which upgrade to start so it finishes while you're awake, for builders, the lab and pets.
• Home, Builder Base and All buttons on the widget fold its sections in one tap.
• Time to max counts supercharges at TH18 and the ore left to max your hero equipment.
• The widget's update notice is quieter.

• More than one account: sync each village and it\'s added by itself. Switch between them with the chips at the top, and pick which one each widget shows.\n• Get help: report a problem, email the developer or join the Discord straight from the main screen.
• The Builder Base shows when your Clock Tower is running, and its timers speed up to match. • Fixed: the Builder Base Reinforcement Camp had no picture and no progress bar.

• Three looks for the app: Widget, Clean and Game. Pick one under Theme.\n• Time to max shows how many of each building are on each level, ticks the maxed ones, and shows their pictures.\n• A tidier main screen: your village at the top, set-up steps folded away.
• Fixed: crafted defence upgrades showed a number and a blank icon instead of their name and picture.
• Time to max: tap it on the main screen to see how long your builders, lab and pets need to max your Town Hall, and what it all costs.
• This What\'s new list, so you can see what each update adds.

• Timers count your Builder\'s Apprentice and Lab Assistant while they\'re working. They add to a potion.\n• A blue HELPER tag marks the upgrade a helper is on.\n• The widget shows when your helpers are ready again.
• Fixed: TH18 Guardians like the Logger were missing.\n• Lab timers account for a Research Potion or Study Soup.
• Event switch for Hammer Jam, so upgrades started at half time get the right progress bar.\n• Opening the app checks for updates straight away.
• A notification when an upgrade finishes.\n• The Exported line turns orange when it\'s time to sync again.\n• The widget tells you when an update is out.
• Fixed: timers count down every second again.\n• Tap a section title on the widget to fold it.
• Clash Sync tile in Quick Settings, so you can sync without leaving the game.\n• The Potion or Bite question only appears for a new boost.

The event switch is on, so upgrades not started yet are %1$d%% off.
Tap a group to see what\'s left in it.

The %% is how much of the upgrade time is done (of the levels, for walls and equipment). Running upgrades count their time left, not their cost. At the highest Town Hall, buildings on their final level also count the supercharges left. Equipment is the ore to max each piece. Not counted yet: the Builder Base, Crafted Defences, and the gear-ups some TH17+ merges need.
